chapter.title: Connected sessions: workspace, protocol, transcript and HTTP proofs
frontier: Only the two named positive/failed Git push cases in pending remain unmapped in the original broker/API/workspace share.
No live provider/account execution, actual product cookie issuance or external GitHub authority is claimed by finite protocol, account-status, CLI-loading and cookie transport boundaries.
guidance: Use the selected task root and explicit permitted service port; never infer provider authority from finite transport or executable-presence observations.
Startup self-check runs invoke the production path. All external provider/account authority and actual product cookie issuance remain distinct from these protocol receipts.

state / scope: Observe the selected local workspace/session, its provider availability, active owner, current run and persisted seen cursor. Current capability state and event cursor belong to the persistent broker.
actions / observe: List/read pages, unread markers, workspace diffs and media; use literal confirmation before local Git changes. Send/control requests preserve run/session identity and retry state.
checks / runtime: Native host guards validate every observation, mapping, filter/pagination result, projected hook/refusal, owner recovery, watchdog selection and HTTP/desktop receipt.

procedures / self_check: Invoke a-sessions production self_check in a guarded isolated process: real scratch Git and SQLite, owned subprocess identities, finite CLI/protocol boundaries, actual loopback HTTP/SSE on explicit 48469, hidden desktop bridge envelopes and both stream disposal paths.

judge / retirement: Retire an original case only with its mapped runtime contracts and a successful current-source receipt; exact migration notes describe expanded current fields, fingerprint options and reasoning notices.

pitfalls.failure: Scratch directories below a checkout can observe the parent repository.
pitfalls.recovery: Use GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES in the confined child before repository observations.

contracts.claim: Git status, branch, detached/upstream identity, line counts, rename/stage metadata, bounded changes and current worktree exactly project observed repository data.
The workspace observer returns a detached JSON copy of its cached observation within TTL; invalidate(cwd) drops that workspace and PR cache.
The file observer resolves paths inside the real repository and bounds patch bytes with a visible truncation marker; nonexistent workspaces and escapes are refused before diff.
Repository mutations accept literal True confirmation only; refusals happen before any repository command or mutation.
Repository actions project actual command exit status, stdout/stderr, visible timeout and bounded output; commit messages are literal arguments and invalid empty/oversized messages are refused.
GitHub identities use supported canonical GitHub URLs and userinfo is removed before remote state reaches clients.
GitHub checks preserve unknown for absent rollups; failure outranks pending, which outranks passing.
Project and linked-worktree branch/remote identity matches Git HEAD/config/commondir observations; ordinary folders remain nonrepositories.
Recent/local folders preserve input order and apply exact query projection and respective 8/30 limits.
Absent GitHub CLI is reported unavailable and repositories stay empty without any account access.
Clone and worktree require confirmation, constrained repository and branch names, and an actual Git repository; unsafe requests fail before processes or directories are created.
Each broker event retains causal order and session identity with one increasing cursor and the actual host device identity.
Published events and the cursor ring obey event/count/byte budgets; evicted bytes exactly reduce the recorded ring total and oversized strings expose truncation while short metadata survives.
An observer returns exactly the ordered retained events after its cursor, or resync outside retained range; initial/new subscribers receive no past events.
Blocking observers wake on publish/close or timeout; new subscribers return at once, and each result passes the same locked cursor contract.

Provider state transitions preserve state, pending request, error and control flags; terminal states expose no active controls or requests. Approval identity is consumed once only after a successful adapter answer; stopping a retired run does not interrupt again.

Successful send/new returns the requested durable run and session identity; request fingerprints reject conflicting replay and one active run owns each session. Refused messages/host/session/adapter requests fail before a provider turn starts.
A Codex sequence is its stable turn ordinal times 8192 plus bounded position times four plus subslot, retaining exact JSON integer ordering.
Codex text preserves short input verbatim and clips long UTF-8 input on complete characters, with the exact omitted-character marker.
Unlabeled/native runtime aliases are native; external or mixed routes are hybrid, with no invented single runtime for mixed routes.
Connected reads require an authenticated session and provider/file mutations require the host owner; an anonymous/guest refusal happens before stream subscription or dispatch.
